name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a conditional rule — whenever the ball is out of the way and the key is not carried, the key must be picked up then or later. The hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures exactly this; the empty FINAL_STATES and rule-only warning are valid since no goal is commanded.

texts: Whenever the blocker is moved out of the door's way, the agent must be carrying the door key at that moment or later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
